player_prompt.intro:
Wo ne Agodifo {player_id} a wɔreko dame Checkers sɛ {color}.
Yɛ wo nua wɔ chess-style nkyerɛkyerɛmu [fileRank fileRank], e.g. '[b2c3]' (sɛtɔn krataa a–h, safu nkyerɛmu 0–7).
Mmara a edi kan:
  • Fa mu kɔ anim kɔn kɔn 1 sɛ ɛwɔ hɔ.
  • Fa agodifo foforo bɔ mu sɛ wɔbɛtow agodifo foforo no.
  • Agodifo biara a ɛkɔ ansa na ɛkɔ awiee no, wɔfrɛ no Ɔhene.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Yɛn nyɛ adwuma boro fɔm no. Fa [a1b2], e.g. [b2c3].

outcome.red_no_pieces: Kɔkɔɔ no nni nnua a aka biara. Abibifo di nkonim!
outcome.black_no_pieces: Ɔdɔdɔm nni nkonyaa biara bio. Kɔkɔɔ di nkonim!
outcome.no_moves: Ɔbɔadeɛ {player_id} nni akwan a ɔde kɔ so.
